title: Observability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Observability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for observability governance: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting requirements. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying observability posture state. Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture — monitoring and management requirements) extended with the modern observability pillar model (logs, metrics, traces). Coherence note: fills a gap identified in the TOGAF coherence audit — TOGAF Technology Architecture monitoring is a core concern not covered by ISO 25010 quality characteristics alone.

loggingRequired.description: Whether structured logging is required. Norm example: Observability.loggingRequired == true.

loggingLevel.description: Minimum logging level required in production. Only meaningful when loggingRequired is true.

metricsRequired.description: Whether metrics emission (e.g., Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) is required.

distributedTracingRequired.description: Whether distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry spans) is required.

alertingRequired.description: Whether alerting rules must be defined for this component.

retentionDays.description: Minimum observability data retention period in days.
